verdict.rationale: BVNK is a payments API platform with an official agent-wallet CLI, so opting out of telemetry is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for the API, portal, or CLI. The webhook validator's client-side operation is an adjacent privacy feature, not a telemetry opt-out, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
